intitule: Exercise 3: Present Simple vs Present Continuous

enonce.texte:
Choose the correct verb form. Use the present simple or present continuous.

Remember: Present simple is for habits, routines, and general facts. Present continuous is for actions happening now.

questions.texte: I ______ (work) as a teacher. Today, I ______ (teach) my students about professions.
My father ______ (be) a doctor. He ______ (operate) on a patient at the moment.
They ______ (study) engineering. Right now, they ______ (build) a bridge.
She ______ (work) in a restaurant. She ______ (serve) customers at the moment.
We usually ______ (eat) lunch at 1 PM, but today we ______ (eat) at 2 PM.

enonce.texte:
Read the paragraph and answer the questions.

My name is Jean, and I am 20 years old. I want to be a pilot. I love flying. I don't like working in an office. I am studying at a flight school now. I also work part-time at a café. My brother, Thomas, is an engineer. He works for a construction company. He is building a hospital now. My sister, Marie, is a nurse. She works at the hospital. She is not working today; she is on holiday.

questions.texte: What is Jean's dream job?
questions.reponse: Jean's dream job is to be a pilot.

questions.texte: Where is Jean studying?
questions.reponse: Jean is studying at a flight school.

questions.texte: What is Thomas's profession?
Is Marie working today?
questions.reponse: No, she is not working today. She is on holiday.

questions.texte: What is Thomas building?

intitule: Exercise 5: Describe Your Daily Work Routine

enonce.texte:
Write a short paragraph (5-6 sentences) describing your daily routine. You can imagine you have a job or describe your routine as a student. Use the present simple and present continuous correctly.

You can talk about:

  • What you do every day
  • What you are doing now
  • What you usually do
  • What you don't like doing

questions.texte: Describe your daily routine. Use at least 5 sentences.
questions.reponse: Example answer: I am a student. I usually wake up at 6 AM. I study English every morning. Right now, I am doing my homework. I don't like waking up early, but I have to. I am also learning to be a teacher.

intitule: Exercise 6: Professions Around Me - A Mini Project

enonce.texte:
Interview two people you know about their jobs. Ask them the following questions and write their answers in a short report.

Questions to ask:

  1. What is your name?
  2. What is your profession?
  3. Where do you work?
  4. What do you do every day?
  5. What are you working on now?
  6. Do you like your job? Why or why not?

Write a report of at least 8 sentences summarizing the interviews.

questions.texte: Write a report of the interviews. Include the information you collected.
questions.reponse: Example answer: I interviewed two people. The first person is John. He is a teacher. He works at a school. He teaches English every day. Right now, he is preparing his lessons. He likes his job because he loves helping students. The second person is Mary. She is a nurse. She works at a hospital. She takes care of patients every day. Right now, she is checking a patient's temperature. She likes her job because she helps people.

enonce.texte:
Write a short essay (10-12 sentences) about your future career goals.

Answer these questions in your essay:

  • What job do you want to do in the future?
  • Why do you want this job?
  • What skills do you need for this job?
  • What are you doing now to prepare for this job?
  • What challenges do you think you will face?
  • How do you think this job will help others?

Use the present simple, present continuous, and future structures correctly.

questions.texte: Write a short essay about your future career goals.
questions.reponse: Example answer: In the future, I want to be a doctor. I want this job because I like helping people. I need to study medicine and learn about the human body. Now, I am studying science and biology. I am also volunteering at a hospital. I know that I will face many challenges, like long hours and difficult cases. However, I think this job will help many people. I am determined to achieve my dream. I will work hard every day. I will not give up. My goal is to become a good doctor and serve my community.

enonce.texte:
Read the scenario and answer the questions.

Scenario: You are 18 years old and you have just finished high school. You want to choose a career. You are not sure whether to become a doctor, an engineer, or a teacher. You need to think about your skills, interests, and the needs of your community. Write a letter to a career counselor explaining your situation and asking for advice.

In your letter, include:

  • Your name and age
  • Your skills and interests
  • Your concerns
  • Your questions for the counselor
  • A conclusion

questions.texte: Write a letter to a career counselor.
questions.reponse: Example answer: Dear Career Counselor, My name is Jean, and I am 18 years old. I just finished high school. I am good at science and I like helping people. I am not sure whether to become a doctor, an engineer, or a teacher. I am worried because I want to choose the right career. I have some questions for you. What are the challenges of each profession? Which job is most needed in our community? How can I learn more about each job? I want to make a good decision. Thank you for your help. Sincerely, Jean.
